name: management-commitments
description: Review company guidance and management commitments against later disclosures, with official-site collection, source evidence and Python comparisons.

interface.longDescription: A local Codex workflow for comparing management statements across quarters. Scripts capture official documents and check evidence, dates, financial definitions and numerical comparisons. A self-contained review dashboard supports source inspection and exported analyst decisions. No additional model API key is required.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $track-management-commitments to compare management guidance with later results and show the changes worth checking.
